title: Earth's four spheres
log: 2026-11-04T09:36:59Z write: the API refused it in the chapter request, so it is written on its own next

draft.title: Earth's four spheres
card: the rock, soil and landforms of Earth, from the surface down to the core.
all living things, such as plants, animals and microbes, and the places where they live.
all the water on Earth, as liquid, ice and water vapour, including oceans, rivers and groundwater.
the layer of gases around Earth. Matter and energy move between all four spheres, so a change in one can affect the others.
draft.remember: Earth's rock, life, water and air are linked, and matter and energy flow between them.

a.q: Which sphere includes the oceans, rivers and ice caps?
a.why: The hydrosphere is all the water on Earth, in liquid, ice and vapour form. The geosphere is tempting because oceans sit on the seafloor, but it is the rock and soil, not the water.
a.clue: Think about what each sphere is made of.

b.q: Rain falls on a hillside in Tasmania and washes soil into a stream. Which two spheres does the moving matter pass between?
b.why: Rain is water, so it is part of the hydrosphere. It moves soil, which is part of the geosphere, into the stream. Biosphere is tempting because a hillside has plants, but the question is about the water and soil moving.
b.clue: Name what the rain is made of and what the soil is.
